Clic : ouvrir une case · clic droit : dr: Click: open a box · right click: flag (then “?”) · click on a number with all the flags placed (or wheel click, or both buttons): open its neighbors · click on the face: new game. The number of a square = the number of mines around. The first click is never a mine. “Without chance”: the board is always resolved by logic. Best times and statistics saved and synchronized.
Le clic droit pose un drapeau, puis un «: Right-clicking places a flag, then a “?” »
Le démineur classique : ouvre toutes les: Classic minesweeper: open every mine-free cell by reading the numbers, flag with a right-click and open a number's neighbours in one click. Beginner, Intermediate, Expert or a custom board, first click always safe, a "no guessing" mode solvable entirely by logic, hints, and best times and streaks per level.
Le plateau se résout toujours par la log: The board is always solved by logic, without ever having to guess
Ouvre une case sûre (+10 s, pas de recor: Opens a safe box (+10 sec, no record)
